# U.S. Core Inflation Rate (Year-over-Year)
## January 2015 - December 2016

| Month | Core CPI YoY (%) |
|---------|------------------|
| Jan 2015 | 1.6 |
| Feb 2015 | 1.7 |
| Mar 2015 | 1.8 |
| Apr 2015 | 1.8 |
| May 2015 | 1.7 |
| Jun 2015 | 1.8 |
| Jul 2015 | 1.8 |
| Aug 2015 | 1.8 |
| Sep 2015 | 1.9 |
| Oct 2015 | 2.0 |
| Nov 2015 | 2.0 |
| Dec 2015 | 2.1 |
| Jan 2016 | 2.2 |
| Feb 2016 | 2.3 |
| Mar 2016 | 2.2 |
| Apr 2016 | 2.1 |
| May 2016 | 2.2 |
| Jun 2016 | 2.3 |
| Jul 2016 | 2.2 |
| Aug 2016 | 2.3 |
| Sep 2016 | 2.2 |
| Oct 2016 | 2.1 |
| Nov 2016 | 2.1 |
| Dec 2016 | 2.2 |

**Note:** Core CPI excludes food and energy prices. During this period, core inflation gradually increased from 1.6% to around 2.2%, approaching the Federal Reserve's 2% target.
